items.title: Japan Credit Rating Agency Upgrades India to 'A' Sovereign Rating After 35 Years
items.summary: The Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded India's sovereign credit rating back to the 'A' grade for the first time since early 1988.

items.title: Tamil Nadu GSDP Expanded by 15.98% in 2024-25 with State Debt at ₹8.53 Lakh Crore: CAG Report
items.summary: According to the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG), Tamil Nadu's Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) expanded by 15.98% in 2024-25. The report also highlights that the total state debt stands at ₹8.53 lakh crore.

items.title: Navy Chief Krishna Swaminathan Visits Australia and New Zealand to Boost Naval Ties
items.summary: Navy Chief Krishna Swaminathan is undertaking visits to Australia and New Zealand to strengthen bilateral naval cooperation. The engagements aim to enhance ties with the Royal Australian Navy and the Royal New Zealand Navy.

items.title: Rajnath Singh Arrives in Sri Lanka for Three-Day Visit
items.summary: Rajnath Singh has arrived in Sri Lanka for a three-day visit to engage with the country's leadership. The visit aims to foster productive bilateral engagement between the two nations.

items.title: Indore Slips from Top Position in 2025 Clean Air Survey to Lucknow
items.summary: Indore lost its top spot in the 2025 clean air survey after falling one point short of Lucknow. Indore had previously topped the list with a maximum score of 200 out of 200.

items.title: Justice Ravindra Vithalrao Ghuge Sworn In as Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court
items.summary: Justice Ravindra Vithalrao Ghuge has been sworn in as the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court. The oath-taking ceremony was attended by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Assembly Speaker Rathindra Bose.

items.title: Chhattisgarh High Court Rules Religious Institutions Cannot Function as Courts
items.summary: The Chhattisgarh High Court held that no religious institution can function as a court while quashing a Triple Talaq order passed by the Idara-E-Shariya Islami Court against a 38-year-old woman from Raipur.

items.title: India and France to Celebrate 2026 as Year of Innovation
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that India and France will celebrate 2026 as the India-France Year of Innovation to strengthen their strategic partnership.

items.title: Public Accounts Committee Flags Failure to Transfer ₹9,222 Crore Cess to Reserve Funds
items.summary: The Parliamentary Public Accounts Committee led by K.C. Venugopal questioned the Finance Ministry regarding the failure to transfer ₹9,222 crore in cess collections into designated reserve funds.

items.title: ISRO and ESA Sign Technical Implementing Plan for Gaganyaan Missions
items.summary: ISRO and the European Space Agency signed a Technical Implementing Plan to provide Ground Tracking Support for Gaganyaan missions and explore future lunar and Venus cooperation.

items.title: India Wins Five Medals at World Archery Para Series Stage III
items.summary: India secured a total of five medals, comprising two gold, two silver, and one bronze, at the World Archery Para Series Stage III.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves Eight Railway Multi-Tracking Projects Costing ₹20,804 Crore
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved eight railway multi-tracking projects worth an estimated ₹20,804 crore to enhance rail connectivity. Key projects include line doubling and third/fourth lines across routes such as Arakkonam-Renigunta, Whitefield-Bangarapet, and Hosur-Omalur.

items.title: UN Nuclear Watchdog Reports Iran to UN Security Council After 20 Years
items.summary: The UN nuclear watchdog board has reported Iran to the UN Security Council for the first time in 20 years regarding its nuclear programme. Western officials suspect traces indicate a past secret nuclear weapons programme, while Iran maintains its activities are entirely peaceful.

items.title: International Space Summit Begins in Paris
items.summary: The International Space Summit has commenced in Paris with participation from 90 countries. The French President announced that over 50 projects expected to bring in billions in investments are set to be signed.

items.title: Sheetal Devi Wins Gold at World Archery Para Series
items.summary: Indian archer Sheetal Devi secured a gold medal at the World Archery Para Series.

items.title: Chhattisgarh Approves ₹500 Crore for NIPUN Mission
items.summary: The state government of Chhattisgarh approved ₹500 crore for the implementation of the NIPUN Mission.

items.title: India to Host Global Dryland Congress 2026
items.summary: India will host the Global Dryland Congress conference scheduled for 2026.

items.title: Justice Pushpendra Bhati Sworn in as Chief Justice of J&K and Ladakh High Court
items.summary: Justice Pushpendra Bhati has taken the oath of office as the Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. The oath was administered by Vinai Kumar Saxena, Lieutenant Governor of UT of Ladakh holding additional charge of UT of Jammu & Kashmir.

items.title: IIM-Kozhikode Rises to 54th Rank in FT Masters in Management Rankings
items.summary: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM-K) advanced 15 positions to achieve 54th rank globally in the Financial Times Masters in Management rankings. The ranking places its flagship postgraduate programme among the top 55 management programmes worldwide.

items.title: Supreme Court Inquires on BCCI Governance Under National Sports Governance Act
items.summary: The Supreme Court has questioned why the BCCI and state cricket bodies should not be governed by the National Sports Governance Act. The inquiry is part of efforts to enhance transparency and accountability in Indian cricket governance.

items.title: UIDAI Launches Aadhaar Face Authentication SDK
items.summary: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has launched the Aadhaar Face Authentication Software Development Kit (SDK).

items.title: UN Chief Antonio Guterres to Address BRICS Summit in India
items.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has been invited to address the Open Session at the BRICS Summit in India. He will focus on multipolarity and UNSC reforms under the summit theme 'Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability: Shaping the Future for Inclusive Global Growth'.

items.title: India to Host 18th BRICS Summit 2026 in New Delhi
items.summary: India will host world leaders in New Delhi on September 12-13 for the 18th BRICS Summit, marking the fourth time India assumes the group's chairmanship.

items.title: India and U.S. Armies Conduct 22nd Edition of Exercise Yudh Abhyas
items.summary: The Indian and U.S. armies are stepping up combat interoperability through the 22nd edition of the bilateral military exercise Yudh Abhyas. The U.S. Army's 3rd Multi-Domain Task Force is participating in the bilateral exercise.

items.title: Home Ministry Discusses Proposed Article 371 Body for Ladakh
items.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs met with LAB and KDA representatives to discuss the proposed structure of a unique UT-level elected body for Ladakh under Article 371.

items.title: Jaishankar Meets Ismaili Leader Prince Rahim Aga Khan V
items.summary: Prince Rahim Aga Khan V, the 50th Imam of the Ismaili Muslims, began his visit to India on September 9 following an invitation from Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan. During the visit, Jaishankar held a meeting with Prince Rahim Aga Khan V.

items.title: PM Modi and German Chancellor Merz Reaffirm Bilateral Cooperation
items.summary: Prime Minister Modi and German Chancellor Merz exchanged views on regional and global developments during a phone call. The two leaders agreed to work closely together to promote global peace, stability, and prosperity.

items.title: India and Canada Aim to Finalise CEPA Trade Deal by Year-End
items.summary: Canadian High Commissioner Christopher Cooter confirmed that India and Canada plan to complete the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) by the end of the year to align with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's planned visit to Canada in December.

items.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping to Visit India After Seven-Year Gap
items.summary: China has confirmed that President Xi Jinping will visit India after seven years to focus on trade and bilateral normalisation. Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao and Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal will hold discussions on the sidelines of the event.

items.title: Shree Charani Becomes Fastest Indian to 50 T20I Wickets
items.summary: Shree Charani has achieved the milestone of becoming the fastest Indian bowler to reach 50 wickets in T20 International cricket.

items.title: Nirbhay Choudhary Sets New Men's Hammer Throw National Record
items.summary: Nirbhay Choudhary broke the existing national record in the men's hammer throw event.

items.title: IMF Welcomes Modernisation of India's Statistical Framework
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has welcomed the ongoing modernisation of India's statistical framework.

items.title: Government Releases DILRMP 3.0 Guidelines
items.summary: The Government of India has officially launched the guidelines for DILRMP 3.0.

items.title: Government Tightens Regulations on E-Commerce Discounts
items.summary: The Government has introduced stricter regulatory measures regarding discount structures offered across e-commerce platforms.

items.title: Dhruva Space and Safran Space Partner for Satellite Supply
items.summary: Indian space firm Dhruva Space has signed a satellite supply deal with Safran Space.

items.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal to Attend G20 Energy Ministerial Meeting in Houston
items.summary: Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal will participate in the G20 Energy Abundance Ministerial Meeting. The meeting is taking place in Houston, USA.

items.title: Union Commerce Minister Proposes Linked Payment Systems at BRICS Business Forum
items.summary: Speaking at the inaugural session of the BRICS Business Forum, Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal called on BRICS nations to link payment systems and trade in local currencies. He noted that BRICS countries represent half of the global population and 40% of global GDP.

items.title: India's Forex Reserves Reach All-Time High of $740.803 Billion
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves rose by a record $44.903 billion to reach a new all-time high of $740.803 billion. In the preceding reporting week, the reserves had grown by $11.475 billion.

items.title: Western Dedicated Freight Corridor Becomes Fully Operational
items.summary: The Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) has become fully operational, creating a 2,843-km freight network in India. This infrastructure serves as a major backbone for the country's national logistics overhaul.

items.title: BRICS Finance Ministers and central bank governors meet under India's chairship in Mumbai
items.summary: BRICS Finance Ministers and central bank governors raised concerns regarding the unilateral imposition of tariffs following a joint statement issued at their meeting in Mumbai. Held under India's chairship of BRICS, this second meeting took place on September 9–10, following an initial meeting on August 12.

items.title: PM Modi Holds Talks with Iranian and Russian Leaders Ahead of BRICS Summit
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held discussions with Iranian President Pezeshkian on protecting navigation and seafarers. He also met Russian President Vladimir Putin in New Delhi to discuss boosting bilateral trade, defence, energy, and critical minerals.

items.title: PM Modi Meets Russian President Vladimir Putin Ahead of BRICS Summit
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin to review bilateral cooperation across defence, energy, space, and other sectors. PM Modi emphasized that dialogue is the way forward and stated India's readiness to assist in peace efforts regarding the Ukraine war.

items.title: PM Modi Addresses BRICS Business Forum on Trade Barriers and Disruptions
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted trade barriers and sea route disruptions at the BRICS Business Forum. Russian President Vladimir Putin discussed shifts in global economic power, while Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian spoke on moving trade away from currency dominance.

items.title: Barrier-free toll booths planned on national highways by March 2027
items.summary: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari stated that barrier-free toll booths will be introduced on national highways by March 2027. He added that complete FASTag implementation is set to yield an annual financial benefit of ₹25,000 crore to the government.

items.title: UN Secretary-General meets PM Modi to discuss West Asia and Ukraine conflicts
items.summary: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres held a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi to discuss ongoing conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine. The UN Chief expressed appreciation for India's close cooperation with the United Nations.

items.title: PM Modi Meets Iranian President Pezeshkian to Discuss West Asia Conflict
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, calling for dialogue and diplomacy to resolve the West Asia conflict. PM Modi highlighted concerns regarding energy supply disruptions and stressed the need to ensure freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Government Mandates One-Month Complaint Resolution Window for E-Commerce Platforms
items.summary: New amended rules require e-commerce platforms to resolve consumer complaints within one month. The policy, operational from January 1, 2027, also mandates e-sellers to display the original price of goods when announcing discounts.

items.title: PM Modi and Xi Jinping to Hold Bilateral Talks on Sidelines of BRICS Summit
items.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold bilateral talks on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit. China called for a strategic and long-term view of bilateral relations ahead of the meeting.

items.title: Researchers Report First Complete Mitochondrial Genome of Malabari Goat
items.summary: Researchers from Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University reported the first complete mitochondrial genome of the Malabari goat. The study provides molecular evidence supporting goat movement along the historic Indian Ocean Spice Route.

items.title: BRICS Leaders Meet in India for Annual Summit
items.summary: BRICS leaders convened in India for their summit amidst global conflicts and international tensions. The meeting highlighted India's diplomatic efforts to balance ties with Russia, Iran, the U.S., and Europe.

items.title: BRICS Summit Issues New Delhi Declaration
items.summary: The BRICS summit chaired by the Prime Minister issued the New Delhi Declaration, calling for maximum restraint in ongoing wars and emphasizing peace.

items.title: India-Russia Bilateral Trade Target Set at $100 Billion by 2030
items.summary: India and Russia have set a bilateral trade target of $100 billion to be achieved by the year 2030.

items.title: Endangered Pygmy Hog Population Reaches 194 via Captive Breeding
items.summary: The population of the endangered pygmy hog has increased from six in 1996 to 194 through a captive breeding programme in Assam.

items.title: PM Modi and President Xi Welcome Progress in India-China Bilateral Relations
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed steady progress in India-China bilateral relations. PM Modi stated that peace and tranquillity in border areas are essential for bilateral development, while President Xi referred to both nations as key Global South countries with significant responsibilities.

items.title: Rajasthan High Court Rules Resigned Govt Employees Contesting Polls Cannot Seek Reinstatement
items.summary: The Rajasthan High Court ruled that a government employee who quits to contest elections cannot seek reinstatement in service. The court upheld the Central Administrative Tribunal's finding that contesting an election as a political party candidate violates the requirement of maintaining political neutrality.

items.title: BRICS Leaders Stress Health Cooperation in New Delhi Declaration
items.summary: BRICS leaders called for stronger cooperation in disease surveillance and medical product regulation in their New Delhi Declaration. They stressed the importance of strengthening health infrastructure and local production to enhance preparedness for future health emergencies.

items.title: 'Woman Unknown' Wins Top Prize at Venice Film Festival
items.summary: 'Woman Unknown' won the top prize at the Venice Film Festival, while John Malkovich was named best actor. Additionally, an Israeli-made Gaza documentary was awarded the special jury prize.

items.title: India Reaches Junior Women’s Asia Cup Final with 5-1 Win Over South Korea
items.summary: India advanced to the final of the Junior Women’s Asia Cup after defeating South Korea 5-1, powered by a hat-trick from Supriya. India will face the winner of the second semifinal between hosts China and Japan in the summit clash.

items.title: OPU-IVF Calf Born in Badri Cattle Breed Conservation Milestone
items.summary: An OPU-IVF calf was born in Badri cattle, marking a major milestone in indigenous breed conservation.

items.title: Colombo Security Conclave Table Top Exercise Concludes in Visakhapatnam
items.summary: The Table Top Exercise under the Colombo Security Conclave concluded in Visakhapatnam.

items.title: Southern Railway Achieves 100% Electrification
items.summary: Southern Railway has successfully achieved 100% electrification across its routes.

items.title: Defence Ministry report notes S-400 air-defence engagement in Operation Sindoor
items.summary: According to the Defence Ministry's annual report, the S-400 air-defence system destroyed a Pakistani aircraft at a range of 314 km during Operation Sindoor. The report highlighted the engagement as a demonstration of the Indian Air Force's long-range air-defence capability.

items.title: Dhiraj Wins Historic Men’s Recurve Gold at Archery World Cup Final
items.summary: Dhiraj won a historic men’s recurve gold medal at the Saltillo World Cup Final by defeating Japan's Nakanishi Junya 6-5 in a tie-breaker shoot-off.

items.title: India Wins Record-Extending Eighth Women’s Asia Cup Title
items.summary: India defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the final to clinch a record-extending eighth Women’s Asia Cup title.

items.title: India Defeats Korea 4-1 to Win Record Sixth Asia Cup Title
items.summary: India defeated Korea 4-1 to lift the continental Asia Cup title for a record sixth time, having previously won in 2004, 2008, 2015, 2023, and 2024.

items.title: UN Secretary-General Clarifies Position on UN Maps Following India's Objections
items.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres stated that there is no official 'UN map with borders' after India pointed out anomalies in a map used by the United Nations. The issue was raised by India during the UN's 'Correct the Map' resolution.

items.title: India restarts discussions for India-Africa Forum Summit on BRICS sidelines
items.summary: India has restarted discussions on the next India-Africa Forum Summit following talks held by Prime Minister Modi with leaders from the African continent. The bilateral outreach discussions took place on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit.

items.title: IAF's Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team to perform at Meerut airshow
items.summary: The Indian Air Force's Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team (SKAT) is scheduled to perform aerobatic displays at an airshow in Meerut. The performance will highlight precision manoeuvres including inverted flying, loops, and barrel rolls.

items.title: Alexander Zverev Wins U.S. Open Title
items.summary: Alexander Zverev defeated eighth seed Ben Shelton to win the U.S. Open men's singles title.

items.title: Tanvi Patri Wins U17 Title at Badminton Asia Junior Championships
items.summary: Tanvi Patri defeated Shaina Manimuthu 11-15, 15-10, 15-12 in an all-Indian final to win the U17 title at the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.

items.title: Union Home Minister Amit Shah Delivers Message on Hindi Diwas 2026
items.summary: Union Minister of Home Affairs and Cooperation Shri Amit Shah issued an official message on the occasion of Hindi Diwas 2026.

items.title: Government Notifies Changes Under Payment and Settlement Act, 2007 for UPI Charges
items.summary: The government notified changes under the Payment and Settlement Act, 2007, keeping UPI transactions up to ₹2,000 free of charges. A decision regarding the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) for higher-value payments is yet to be finalized.

items.title: U.S. Lawmaker Proposes Amendment Naming India in Russia Sanctions Act
items.summary: An amendment naming India was submitted in the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which was passed by the U.S. Senate by an 86-11 vote. The act targets Russia's leadership, energy sector, and shadow fleet vessels used to evade oil sanctions.

items.title: India Approves Expedited Electricity Export to Nepal
items.summary: India's Ministry of Power has approved the expedited export of electricity to flood-hit Nepal to meet its power requirements. The initiative aims to strengthen energy cooperation between the two nations.

items.title: Justice V. Kameswar Rao Sworn In as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
items.summary: Justice V. Kameswar Rao has taken the oath of office as the Chief Justice of the Patna High Court. The ceremony took place at Lok Bhavan in the presence of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.

items.title: India and Canada Resume Talks for Proposed Bilateral Trade Pact
items.summary: India and Canada have initiated the next round of negotiations for a proposed trade agreement. Both countries have set a target to increase their bilateral trade to $50 billion by the year 2030.

items.title: Wholesale Price Index Inflation Rises to 9.92% in August
items.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation increased to 9.92% in August owing to rising prices of food, fuel, and manufactured items. WPI inflation in manufactured items hit a series high of 8.37%, rising from 8.29% recorded in July.

items.title: West Asia war LIVE: Saudi Arabia warns it will react 'firmly' to Houthi attacks
items.summary: Saudi Arabian ‌Civil Defence sent an alert on September 15, ​after issuing alerts for potential danger ‌in six cities, including Yanbu, ‌the kingdom's ‌main ⁠Red Sea oil ⁠port, where millions of barrels a day ​are loaded

items.title: Pakistan court orders blocking passports of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa CM, 24 lawmakers of Imran Khan's party
items.summary: The order comes amid heightened political activity by the PTI, which has announced a nationwide protest for September 27

items.title: Drone shot down by NATO over Lithuania
items.summary: Baltic states Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia — NATO members sharing a long border with Russia — regularly report drone incursions into their territories as part of Moscow's war with Ukraine.

items.title: Pakistan mulls revival of austerity measures amid West Asia hostilities
items.summary: The indication of a possible revival of austerity measures came as petrol prices rose to PKR 375.82 per litre and high-speed diesel (HSD) to PKR 403.32 per litre

items.title: Trump nominates Wesley Hunt to serve as U.S. Ambassador to Saudi; picks wife of 'God Bless the USA' singer as envoy to Barbados
items.summary: The Republican lawmaker is near the end of his second term representing his Houston-area district and has served as a U.S. Army officer who served as a diplomatic liaison in Saudi Arabia

items.title: Asian Games venues and athletes unharmed by extensive flooding in Nagoya, Japan
items.summary: Hirosawa said about 400 athletes and staff who are staying in converted shipping containers — remodeled to serve as temporary housing units for the Asian Games — were briefly evacuated to higher ground during the heavy rain

items.title: Who is fugitive Khadeer Khan Mohammed? | Explained
items.summary: Why is Khadeer Khan Mohammed wanted by U.S. authorities in an alleged $93 million Medicare genetic-testing fraud case? What is the status of the investigation that began in 2025? What could happen next if he is in India?

items.title: How EU plans to keep children under 15 off social media
items.summary: Under a proposal being prepared by the European Commission, children under 15 could face restrictions on creating and using accounts across a wide range of digital services

items.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs
items.summary: The Queen of Country Music, who passed away recently, gave away more than 300 million books and millions of dollars in aid, but refused to surrender the copyright to one song, even for Elvis Presley.

items.title: U.S. has weapons deployed in orbit, Space Force says
items.summary: "The U.S. has on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action," a U.S. Space Force spokesperson said in a statement that did not provide specifics on the weapons

items.title: Houthi attack in southern Saudi Arabia wounds 13: Riyadh-led coalition
items.summary: "On September 14, the Militia launched attacks on civilian objects in the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Taif with several ballistic missiles and drones,” says coalition spokesman

items.title: Trump says there is ‘SICK conspiracy’ against AI and data centres, dismisses new guardrails
items.summary: “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Mr. Trump said

items.title: In loss for Trump, U.S. Supreme Court won't let Postal Service restrict mail ballots
items.summary: Justice Samuel Alito, joined by fellow conservative Justice Clarence Thomas, dissented from the decision, comparing some ‌of the challengers’ claims to a “Hail Mary pass” that is “unlikely to be successfully completed,” using a football analogy

items.title: NATO fighter jet shoots down drone in Lithuania
items.summary: Origin yet to be determined; drone alert was issued earlier in ​the capital ‌Vilnius and surrounding region.

items.title: BRICS: A strategic balancer?
items.summary: BRICS: A strategic balancer?

items.title: Police arrest man after multiple people wounded in China knife attack
items.summary: A video seemingly captured from CCTV showed a man in a face mask stabbing a woman in the face as he walked past her in front of a restaurant.

items.title: U.S. Judge blocks Trump limits on duration of visas for foreign students, journalists
items.summary: U.S. ​Department of Homeland Security adopted the policy ‌based on “exceptionally weak” rationales, the Judge said

items.title: Houthis say Saudi Arabia hits Yemen with 54 strikes after attack on bases
items.summary: Saudi civil defence issued a brief alert for Najran in southwestern Saudi Arabia without elaborating on the cause for the warning

items.title: Russia hits petrol station, warehouse facilities in Kyiv, Mayor says
items.summary: Russia has recently ‌started hitting petrol stations in Kyiv, expanding the range of target facilities. In recent months, Russia hit some 300 petrol stations, mainly in or near ‌Ukraine’s frontline regions.

items.title: French power sector labour strike takes 6.5 gigawatts offline overnight
items.summary: Workers ‌and retirees in the French energy sector pay discounted rates, which their unions view as a core part of their compensation package; strike is expected to go ⁠through the day on September 15, suggesting the outages could be renewed or increased
